visuals.heading: Money Is the Only Reason to Stay

items.text: None of that is a reason to stay by itself.
The goal is not a new title.
Add practical AI and automation to the domain knowledge you already earned.
Career researchers keep landing on the same window: the 5-to-7-year mark is where career plateaus most reliably predict voluntary exits.
India's job market data backs this up from a different angle.
None of this means every 5-year professional should quit.

blocks.heading: Money Is the Only Reason to Stay
rows: Exact vesting date, current value, and whether it is real liquidity or paper value at a private company
Worth waiting a few months for if it vests soon and is genuinely liquid; not worth years of a wrong-fit job for paper value
The exact clawback clause and lock-in date, not the headline number
Fine to wait out a short lock-in; a bad reason to sign a longer one just to avoid making a decision
What the new field or role actually pays at your experience level, not what you assume it pays
A real trade-off to plan for financially, not a reason to avoid the market-demand check below
Whether the discomfort of switching is temporary (a learning curve) or the discomfort of staying is permanent (a ceiling)
Usually the weakest reason to stay once you name it out loud

blocks.heading: Not Senior Enough to Lead" Trap

items.text: This is the specific bind that makes year 5 harder than year 2 or year 10.

blocks.heading: Stops Being "Job-Hopping" and Becomes a Reset

items.text: One clean move at year 5, framed around a specific capability gain, reads as a deliberate reset.
Keep your existing 3-to-6-month emergency fund untouched, that is for genuine emergencies, not for funding a career change.

If you plan to quit before you have new income lined up, budget for at least 6 months of expenses, and closer to 12 months if the plan includes unpaid upskilling, a lower starting offer in the new field, or a gap while you search.
Is 5 years too early to change careers in India.
No.
A single considered switch after 5 years, with a clear before-and-after story and one or two roles of reasonable tenure behind it, does not read as job-hopping to most hiring managers.

items.text: Weeks 1-2: Finish the skills transfer audit above on paper.

Weeks 3-6: Start one small, real proof-of-work piece in the new field: a project, a certification with a practical output, a volunteer assignment, or a documented case study, something you can show, not just describe.
Compare that list against what you built in weeks 3-6 and close the gap that matters most.
Weeks 11-13: Review honestly.
